title: Razer’s new keyboards drop the price on powerful gaming features
summary: The Huntsman V3 HE Magnetic TKL and Mini look like most other Razer boards (a little ugly), but they’re loaded up with competitive gaming tech. But the magnetic Huntsman pair both sound much better to my ears than Razer’s pricier models.
